title: Helpdesk & Ticketing — User Manual
summary: How the ticket status workflow, comments, attachments, and satisfaction ratings work.

sections.body:
Overview

Helpdesk & Ticketing is the IT support queue. Tickets can optionally be linked to an asset, carry a priority, and move through a fixed status workflow.

Key Features

  • Status workflow buttons on the ticket detail page: OPEN → IN PROGRESS → RESOLVED → CLOSED.
  • Comments, with an "Internal note (staff only)" toggle for notes the requester never sees.
  • Attach File for supporting screenshots/logs.
  • Watch / Watching to get notified of updates on tickets you care about.
  • QR Code on a ticket detail page generates a scannable code linking straight back to that ticket.
  • Once a ticket is RESOLVED, the requester can Rate this resolution and Submit Rating.

Step-by-Step

  1. Create a ticket, optionally linking it to the affected asset, and set a priority.
  2. Move it through the status buttons as work progresses: OPEN → IN PROGRESS → RESOLVED → CLOSED.
  3. Use Comments to keep the requester updated; use the internal-note toggle for anything staff-only.
  4. Click Watch on any ticket you want update notifications for.
